description: Long-only cascade reversal on 12 USD-M perpetuals: after a 5-minute close more than k sigma below the previous close (sigma = EWMA std of 5-minute log returns over the previous ~day), post a limit buy 1 sigma below that close, valid 10 minutes; exit at the open 240 minutes after the fill. No take-profit, no stop. 20 % of equity per trade, one trade per coin, open notional capped at 1x equity.
selection: best Sharpe on the design period 2023-08-01 → 2024-09-01 among 64 long-only variants (all profitable there)

second_half_2024-09_2025-10.note: not a clean confirmation: the long-only idea came from looking at both halves (the both-sides version failed here)

reference_only: k=7 and k=6, same other params
